full_prompt_en: A square stylized oil painting shows a woman standing in left profile before an expansive sky of outlined pale clouds and low orange land. The sky fills the upper two-thirds with blue and lavender horizontal bands. Large cream and blush cloud lobes crowd behind the woman, each rounded section traced by a fine blue gray line, so the mass reads as both weather and an intricate pattern. Near the bottom, thin warm orange and cool blue stripes mark the distant horizon above broad ochre ground. Low gray stones gather at the lower edges. The woman occupies the central foreground from head to the cropped lower dress. Her dark hair is drawn smoothly back into a low bun, leaving her forehead, straight nose and calm mouth clear against the clouds. She looks left with a composed expression and an upright posture. A blue high collar and tied scarf or bow sit at her neck. Over it she wears a dark navy jacket or fitted upper garment with small buttons and softly folded sleeves. The long skirt below is a deep blue black, built from narrow vertical brush marks that give the otherwise solid silhouette weight. Her nearer hand rests inside a side pocket, with a pale cuff visible at the wrist. The other side of the body falls into a quieter dark plane. The head and neck are lightly modeled in warm muted skin tones, but broad color areas and deliberate dark contours govern most of the scene. Light comes softly from the open sky at upper left, giving the face a warm edge and the clouds pale illuminated tops; the dress stays comparatively dark. The background ground and sky are flattened into layered bands, while the woman retains more volume through fabric folds and face shading. The overall composition places a calm vertical figure against restless circular clouds and horizontal landscape stripes, balancing dark blue with cream, lavender and glowing ochre.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形风格化油画描绘一位女子朝左侧面站立，身后是铺展的浅色描线云团与低矮橙色大地。天空以蓝色和薰衣草色水平带占满上方约三分之二。巨大的奶油色与浅粉色云瓣挤在女子身后，每个圆润部分都由细蓝灰线描出，使云团既像天气，也像复杂纹样。靠近底部，细暖橙与冷蓝条带标记远处地平线，下方是宽阔赭土地面。低矮灰石聚在下方边缘。女子从头到被截断的裙摆占据中央前景。深色头发顺滑地向后拢成低髻，额头、挺直鼻梁和平静嘴角在云前清楚。她以端正姿态望向左侧，神情沉着。蓝色高领和系起的围巾或领结位于颈间。外面是一件深藏蓝夹克或收腰上衣，带小纽扣和柔和折起的袖子。下方长裙是深蓝黑色，由狭长竖向笔痕构成，使原本结实的剪影带有重量。靠近观者的手放在侧袋里，腕处露出浅色袖口。身体另一侧落在较安静的深色平面中。头颈用低饱和暖肤色轻轻塑形，但宽阔色块与有意的深轮廓支配大部分场景。光柔和地来自左上方开阔天空，给面部一圈暖边，让云顶呈浅亮；裙装保持相对深暗。背景的大地与天空被压平为层叠色带，女子则通过衣褶与面部明暗保留更多体积。整体构图把安静的竖向人物放在躁动的圆云与水平风景条带前，以深蓝平衡奶油色、薰衣草色和发亮赭色。
style_prompt_en: The image has a stylized oil-painted surface where fine dark outlines divide rounded pale forms and broad horizontal color bands. Deep navy and blue black provide one solid vertical weight, while cream, blush lavender and ochre occupy larger, lighter surrounding regions. Small directional strokes give dark areas texture, and smoother planar paint keeps the pale areas calm. Repeated circular lobes form a dense upper rhythm, contrasted with low, thin parallel stripes. Light is diffuse from an open upper side, gently warming exposed edges without strong cast shadows. The space is compressed and decorative, yet restrained modeling on focal planes preserves volume. The overall effect is poised and lyrical, with outlined curves and layered color making a clear balance between stillness and movement.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有风格化油画表面，细深轮廓把圆润浅色形体和宽阔水平色带分开。深藏蓝与蓝黑色提供一块结实竖向重量，奶油色、浅粉紫和赭色占据更大、更亮的周围区域。短而有方向的笔触给深色区域肌理，较平滑的平面颜料让浅色区域安静。重复圆瓣构成密集的上方节奏，与下部细薄平行条带对照。光从上方开阔的一侧漫射而来，温和加暖暴露边缘，没有强投影。空间压缩而具装饰性，焦点平面上克制的塑形仍保留体积。整体效果端正而抒情，描线曲面和层叠色彩在静止与运动间建立清楚平衡。
theme_en: A woman in dark blue dress standing in profile before patterned clouds and orange land
theme_zh: 一位穿深蓝裙装的女子侧身立在纹样云层与橙色大地前
name: Ferdinand Hodler
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
